transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I need to put together tomorrow's 0600-1800 support roster, assigning Sgt. Hale, Cpl. Ortiz, Spc. Lin, and Pfc. Reed to the four posts: dispatch desk, fuel point, motor pool release desk, and clinic transport post. Before I publish the final roster, I'd like to hear from each of you on your leads' requirements and any qualification concerns. Let's start with what you each know.

transcript.text: I need to flag a qualification concern. I received a certification update from the signal school this morning: Sgt. Hale has completed the current dispatch-system certification, but the other three personnel — Cpl. Ortiz, Spc. Lin, and Pfc. Reed — have not. The personnel qualification board has not yet been updated with this information, so only Sgt. Hale is currently qualified for the dispatch desk.
